theater: 張家口野狐嶺與蔚州澮河堡

battle.name: 野狐嶺會戰
battle.theater: 張家口野狐嶺與蔚州澮河堡
battle.brief: 金宣宗興祐元年（一二一一年）八月，成吉思汗在張家口野狐嶺隘口擊潰金軍主力，十月前後追殲於蔚州澮河堡，金軍全軍覆沒。木華黎由獾兒嘴奇道插入，蒙古騎兵下馬步戰破中軍，成吉思汗再以三千騎作最後一擊。配重投石車未列此役；同一戰線上對涿州、中都的攻城與繳獲的工匠，才是蒙古攻城能力的來源。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 交戰一方是金朝，完顏氏女真人在中都建立的王朝，軍隊由契丹、女真、漢地三種人丁組成，戰時由尚書省下樞密院調兵，臨前線設統軍司屯戍。金廷先把主力交給平章政事獨吉思忠，讓他率兵赴西北前線；野狐嶺敗後改由完顏承裕接任，下令放棄恆州、昌州、撫州三座邊城，縮進山道與隘口布防。金軍步卒數量雖大，可用騎兵卻遠不如蒙古精騎，漢軍多派來守城、填壕、修壘，難以在荒野裡與騎兵爭鋒。另一方是蒙古帝國，一二〇六年忽里勒台之後成吉思汗統合漠北諸部，軍制以千戶為單位，怯薛近衛護住大汗，作戰全靠騎兵與隨軍馬群。蒙古分三路入塞：成吉思汗自將中路，哲別為前鋒，指向中都；右翼由術赤、察合台、窩闊台率領，掃蕩內蒙古與山西一帶，截住金廷送往西北的援兵；左翼小隊在臨潢府一帶搜索巡邏。兩軍都把壺流河谷地與野狐嶺的山脊當成同一個戰場：一邊想用地形抵住騎兵，一邊要在別人選定的地形上把對方吃掉。
countriesEn: One belligerent was the Jin dynasty, founded by the Jurchen Wanyan clan with its capital at Zhongdu, its field army drawn from Khitan, Jurchen and Han populations, mustered by the Privy Council under the Department of State Affairs with military commissions and commanderies garrisoning the frontier. The court first entrusted the main body to the chancellor Duji Sizhong for the northwestern front; after the defeat at Yehuling it put Wanyan Chengyu in his place and ordered the abandonment of Hengzhou, Changzhou and Fuzhou, concentrating the army in the mountain tracks and passes. The Jin had foot soldiers in great numbers but far too few usable horses, and the Han troops were assigned to hold walls, fill ditches and raise fieldworks rather than to fight cavalry in open country. The other side was the Mongol Empire, unified on the steppe after the kurultai of 1206, its army organised in units of a thousand with the keshig guarding the Khan, and fighting entirely on horseback with remounts following the columns. The Mongols entered in three divisions: Genghis Khan in the centre with Jebe in the vanguard, moving toward Zhongdu; the right wing under Jochi, Chagatai and Ögedei sweeping central Inner Mongolia and Shanxi to cut off the reinforcements the Jin court was sending northwest; and a small detachment scouting around Linhuangfu. Both armies fixed on the same ground, the valley of the Huliuchong and the ridge above Yehuling: one side hoped to use the terrain to hold off cavalry, the other meant to eat the enemy on ground the enemy had chosen.
people: 成吉思汗是全場的決策者。他先在一二〇九至一二一〇年間攻下西夏，穩住南邊，再把矛頭指向金朝；金使來索取舊日貢賦，他不從，戰爭由此而起。他又用計策把奉命來議和的契丹官員石抹明安說動留下，反過來取得金軍在西北的部署與兵糧情報。木華黎統率的八魯營是會戰的刀鋒：蒙古軍取道獾兒嘴這條山縫奇道插入敵陣，他當眾立下不勝不還的軍令，士氣為之一振。地形逼得蒙古騎兵下馬步戰，木華黎所部靠刀矛撕開金軍中軍，前線主將完顏九斤戰死陣中，金軍兩翼想支援卻被山道隔斷。哲別作為前鋒，替大軍清理通道、盯住退路；術赤、察合台、窩闊台三子率右翼在山西與內蒙古一帶掃蕩，拖住金廷往西北調動的援兵。澮河堡一役，成吉思汗親率三千騎兵衝鋒，把潰散殘軍徹底壓住，完顏承裕僅以身免。事後金廷撤換主將，改由徒單鎰出任平章政事；中都城內又發生政變，部將胡沙虎殺死金主完顏永濟奪權。
peopleEn: Genghis Khan was the decision maker throughout. He had broken Western Xia between 1209 and 1210 to settle his southern flank and only then turned on the Jin; when Jin envoys came to demand his old tribute he refused, and the war grew out of that refusal. He also worked on the Khitan official Shimo Ming'an, who had been sent to negotiate, persuaded him to stay, and thereby turned over the Jin deployment and stores in the northwest. Muqali's Balu unit was the blade of the battle: the Mongols took the narrow track through Huan'erzui to slip into the enemy position, and Muqali swore before the army that he would not come back alive unless he defeated the Jin, which raised the morale of the whole army. The ground forced the Mongol horsemen to fight on foot, and Muqali's men cut through the Jin centre with sabre and spear; the front-line commander Wanyan Jiujin was killed in the fighting, and the Jin wings could not come up because the mountain tracks separated them. Jebe, in the vanguard, cleared the road for the main body and watched the retreat; Jochi, Chagatai and Ögedei swept Shanxi and Inner Mongolia on the right wing, holding off the reinforcements the Jin court was moving northwest. At Huihe Fortress Genghis Khan led three thousand horsemen in the charge that crushed the routed Jin, and Wanyan Chengyu escaped with his life alone. The court then replaced its commander, appointing Tushan Yi chancellor, and in Zhongdu a coup by the general Hushahu killed the Jin sovereign Wanyan Yongji and seized the government.
kits: 卡面這件配重投石車是歐洲十二世紀的產物：一支長臂，末端掛皮兜，另一端墜上配重石，兩端同時落下時把石彈甩過城牆，射程遠勝靠人力拉索的中國拋石機。但野狐嶺現場沒有這件兵器——那是一場山地會戰，決定勝負的是馬匹、刀矛與指揮，投石車無處可用。它真正落場的時機是同一條戰爭線的攻城階段：蒙古軍一二一三至一二一五年圍涿州、一二一四年起攻中都，用的是從漢地取得的絞索式拋石機；金守軍則以壕溝、木柵、雲梯與火藥震天雷應對。配重式版本還要再晚一步，十三世紀後期回回工程師造出長臂配重加皮兜的回回砲，《元史·兵志》記它一發所中，人馬皆碎，才把這類武器推到極限，其後襄陽城下所用即是同一類配重拋石機。蒙古自野狐嶺起連續攻取邊城，繳獲大批攻城器械與漢地工匠，技術與人力同時落進草原軍隊。此外蒙古靠蒙古弓、蒙古刀、皮甲與耐粗飼的矮馬作戰，馬背上的奶桶與肉乾就是全部給養；金軍有射程遠的神臂弓、有鎧甲有火藥，卻缺馬——這正是會戰裡弓弩與刀矛之外那個補不上的差距。
kitsEn: The trebuchet on the card is a product of twelfth-century Europe: a long beam with a leather sling at one end and a counterweight at the other, so that when the short arm falls the stone is whipped over the wall, well beyond the reach of the Chinese traction trebuchets worked by manpower. None of it was present at Yehuling, for that was a battle fought among mountains, decided by horses, sabres and command, and there was no place for a stone-thrower. The weapon entered the war at the siege stage of the same front: the Mongols besieging Zhuozhou from 1213 and striking at Zhongdu from 1214 worked the traction trebuchets they had taken in the Chinese lands, while the Jin answered with ditches, wooden palisades, scaling ladders and the gunpowder bomb called the thunder-shaking thunder. The counterweight form came one step later, when Muslim engineers in the late thirteenth century produced the huihui pao, a long counterweighted arm with a sling, which the Yuan history records as shattering men and horses on every shot; that pushed this class of weapon to its limit, and the counterweight trebuchet worked against Xiangyang later in the thirteenth century was of the same kind. From Yehuling onward the Mongols took border cities one after another and captured siege equipment and Han craftsmen by the thousand, so that both the technology and the manpower passed into the steppe army. Around them stood the Mongol bow, the Mongol sabre, leather armour and the tough short horse, with the panniers of milk and dried meat as the entire supply system; the Jin had the long-range divine arm crossbow, armour and gunpowder, but they lacked horses, and that was the gap no amount of equipment on the field could close.
tactics: 蒙古的辦法是分進合擊再集中突擊。大軍分三路南下，一路掃邊，一路牽制援兵，主力沿通往中都的方向推進，把金廷的注意力釘死在西北。金軍的部署是放棄三座邊城、退守山道，想用地形抵消蒙古的騎兵優勢，但數十萬級別的步卒散在山間與谷口，前軍、中軍、兩翼彼此望不見旗號，命令靠驛騎與金鼓傳遞，一入山道就斷。蒙古正好利用這一點：木華黎率八魯營從獾兒嘴奇道插進，狹窄地形逼蒙古騎兵下馬步戰，哲別的前鋒與各路大軍同時壓向金軍中軍，兩翼金軍想支援卻過不來。金軍中軍一破，前線主將完顏九斤陣亡，全軍失去目標，潰散中被追殺數十里。追到澮河堡，成吉思汗用蒙古的老辦法處理：包圍三日，把金軍與援軍隔絕，同時以騎兵反覆衝擊缺口，直到完顏承裕帶走殘部，大汗再以三千騎作最後一擊。金廷得到的教訓是防禦縱深不夠——真正保命的不是城牆，而是城牆外能不能擋住蒙古的騎兵。
tacticsEn: The Mongols divided to converge and then concentrated on a single point. The army came in three columns, one sweeping the frontier, one pinning the reinforcements, and the main body driving toward Zhongdu so as to pin the attention of the Jin court on the northwest. The Jin plan was to abandon three border towns, fall back into the mountain tracks and use the terrain to cancel the Mongol advantage in horsemen, but an infantry force numbering in the tens of thousands was scattered among the hills and valley mouths; the front, the centre and the wings could no longer see one another's standards, and orders travelled by courier horse and drum signal, which the mountain roads cut off. The Mongols took advantage of exactly that: Muqali led the Balu unit in through the Huan'erzui path, the narrow ground forced the riders to dismount and fight on foot, and Jebe's vanguard and the columns closed on the Jin centre at once while the wings could not come up. When the centre broke and the front-line commander Wanyan Jiujin fell, the army lost its purpose and was run down over tens of li. At Huihe Fortress Genghis Khan applied the old Mongol method: three days of encirclement to cut the Jin off from any relief, repeated mounted charges against the gaps, and finally three thousand horsemen as the last blow, until Wanyan Chengyu led off a remnant. The lesson the Jin drew was that its defence had no depth; what preserves an army is not the wall but whether the enemy horsemen can be stopped outside the wall.
data: 時間線：《金史》與《元史》一類記載把蒙古集兵繫於一二一一年春的克魯倫河，兩萬人留守後方，先取豐利與烏沙堡等邊哨；同年八月在獾兒嘴與野狐嶺交鋒，十月前後在蔚州澮河堡殲滅金軍殘部。兵力口徑分歧極大：史家 Ratchnevsky 估蒙古軍為六萬五千人，另有翁古部一萬輔助騎兵；金廷自報六十萬，其中步卒五十萬、騎兵十二萬，另有學者指金在西北前線實際只有三萬至五萬可用。倍數從一比一橫跨到一比十，取哪個數，取決於信哪部史書。地理上，野狐嶺在今河北張家口萬全區，獾兒嘴是山側的狹口，兩地相距數里；由會戰地到澮河堡約六十公里上下。《金史》形容追擊之後屍骸蔽野、填溝皆滿，生還者寥寥，這類描述歷來被指為誇張，實際傷亡可能以數萬計，而非以十萬計。攻城一側另有較硬的記載：金守涿州者以火藥震天雷炸蒙古攻城部隊，蒙古前後在涿州與中都兩役上耗去兩年多，卻始終未能拿下中都。
dataEn: The chronology: histories such as the Jin and Yuan records place the mustering of the Mongols on the Kerulen in the spring of 1211, with twenty thousand men left to guard the homeland, and the taking of Fengli and of the fort at Wusha Bao; the fighting at Huan'erzui and Yehuling came in August, and the destruction of the Jin remnants at Huihe Fortress around October. The strength figures disagree sharply: the historian Ratchnevsky estimated 65,000 Mongols with 10,000 Onggud auxiliaries; the Jin claimed 600,000 in all, 500,000 foot and 120,000 horse; and another estimate puts only 30,000 to 50,000 men actually available on the northwestern front. Depending on which history is believed, the ratio swings between parity and ten to one. Geographically, Yehuling lies in today's Wanquan District of Zhangjiakou in Hebei, Huan'erzui is the gap in the hillside a few li away, and the battlefield stands about sixty kilometres from Huihe Fortress. The Jin history describes the ground after the pursuit as carpeted with the dead and the ditches filled to the brim, with almost none escaping; such passages have long been called exaggerations, and the real losses may run to tens of thousands rather than to hundreds of thousands. The siege side has harder entries: the Jin garrison at Zhuozhou used gunpowder thunder-shaking thunder against the Mongol assault, and the Mongols spent more than two years over Zhuozhou and Zhongdu together without ever taking Zhongdu.
cause: 金朝對漠北草原用了半個多世紀的分化政策：十二世紀中葉聯手塔塔兒人殺掉蒙古部首安巴海，又不斷出兵草原擄掠人口牲畜。蒙古人一度並不記恨，十二世紀末金廷改為拉攏鐵木真，借他的力量去打塔塔兒，封官許以財貨，條件是按年進貢。一二〇六年統一漠北之後，成吉思汗不再接受金朝宗主的名分，到一二一〇年他直接斷了進貢，戰爭由此而起。金廷這邊亦有難處：對西夏用兵剛剛結束，邊堡守軍久屯不戰，堡寨接連失守；完顏永濟接到求和的意向又被蒙古駁回，等於自己放棄了最後緩衝。於是雙方都沒有退路：蒙古要雪安巴海的舊仇、報受辱之恨、奪牧場與財貨，金廷要保住河北的人丁與耕地。開戰前的準備也說明這一點——蒙古刻意在春天沿邊界試探，奪下烏沙堡這種關鍵堡寨，把金軍的邊防線撕開一個口子，逼金廷在沒有談判餘地的情況下應戰。
causeEn: The Jin had spent half a century and more dividing the steppe: in the mid-twelfth century they joined the Tatars in killing the Mongol leader Ambaghai, and they sent troops into the grass again and again to seize people and animals. For a time the Mongols bore no grudge, and late in the twelfth century the Jin court turned to Temüjin, using him against the Tatars and granting titles and wealth on condition of annual tribute. Once the steppe was unified in 1206, Genghis Khan no longer accepted the Jin claim of suzerainty, and in 1210 he simply stopped the tribute; the war grew out of that. The Jin had their own difficulties: the campaign against Western Xia had just ended, frontier garrisons sat in place without fighting, and outposts fell one after another; the overtures for peace that reached Wanyan Yongji were dismissed by the Mongols, so the Jin forfeited the last buffer. Neither side could step back: the Mongols wanted revenge for Ambaghai, redress for insult, herds and wealth, and the Jin court wanted to hold on to the people and fields of Hebei. The preparations before the war show it plainly, for the Mongols probed the border in the spring, took forts such as Wusha Bao and tore a gap in the Jin frontier, so that the court had to fight with no room left for negotiation.
impact: 這一仗把金朝的西北邊防整條拆掉。野狐嶺之後，蒙古三路大軍長驅直入河北，與一二一二年圍涿州、一二一四年攻中都合成同一條戰線；金廷被迫放棄中都，宣宗遷都汴梁，河北與遼東的防禦由野戰退成城池與障牆。金廷此後在邊界修築數百里長的障牆，試圖用工事攔住騎兵，但蒙古人寧可繞過去攻城牆，障牆只守住一條線，另一條線仍然敞開。技術上，蒙古在攻城戰中大量繳獲金軍的投石機、火藥與城防器材，也把漢地工匠帶回草原，配重式的長臂拋石機正是在這條人才流動線上被做成了回回砲，其後在十三世紀後期的襄陽攻防中成為決定攻城與否的裝備。蒙古自己也因此改變，一二一四年前後命木華黎總領漢地軍事，兵制從劫掠轉向編戶定賦、分軍民之治，試著把攻下來的城變成可以收稅的城。金朝又撐了二十多年，卻把主力用在南方攻宋，北面空虛，最終在一二三四年與蒙古聯手滅亡南宋時一同覆沒。野狐嶺從此成為蒙古鐵騎鋒芒的代名詞。
impactEn: The battle broke the whole northwestern defence of the Jin. After Yehuling the three Mongol columns drove deep into Hebei, joining the siege of Zhuozhou in 1212 and the assault on Zhongdu in 1214 into one continuous front; the court had to give up Zhongdu, the Xuanzong Emperor moved the capital to Bianjing, and the defence of Hebei and Liaodong shrank from field battle into cities and barrier walls. The court then built several hundred li of barrier along the border to hold the horsemen off, but the Mongols preferred to go round and strike the cities instead, so the barrier guarded one line while another stood open. Technologically, the Mongols captured enormous quantities of Jin siege engines, gunpowder and fortification material and carried Han craftsmen back to the steppe; it was on this flow of men and skills that the counterweighted long-arm trebuchet was built into the huihui pao, and in the later thirteenth century that weapon became the arbiter of the siege of Xiangyang. The Mongols changed as well: after 1214 Muqali was given overall command in Han territory, and the army turned from plunder toward household registration, fixed taxation and the separation of military and civil administration, trying to turn the cities they had taken into cities that paid. The Jin survived for another twenty years or more, but spent its strength on the Song in the south while the north stood open, and went down in 1234 when it struck together with the Mongols to finish the Southern Song. Yehuling became the standing name for the edge of the Mongol cavalry.
result: 結果是蒙古完勝，而且勝得乾淨。野狐嶺一役金軍中軍崩潰，前線主將完顏九斤戰死；澮河堡一役包圍三日後，成吉思汗親率三千騎兵作最後一擊，金軍全軍覆沒，總帥完顏承裕僅以身免。平章政事換了兩任，金主完顏永濟在中都被部將胡沙虎殺死，金廷由中都退到汴梁，河北平原那道屏障就此改寫。蒙古從此取得三樣東西：能持續作戰的漢地糧秣與鐵器、能攻城的中原工匠，以及一套以攻代守的方法——不必死守自己的城牆，只要把對方的軍隊在野外消滅掉。金朝並未立刻滅亡，仍守著半壁江山直到一二三四年，但防禦已經由進攻轉為挨打。對配重投石車這件兵器來說，野狐嶺不是它的戰場，這裡沒有砲兵參與；但這場戰爭為它提供了資金、材料與人，蒙古正是靠這些攻城能力打進了河北，之後又沿同一條技術線做出配重砲，最終把南方那座從未陷落的襄陽城敲開。工程比武器更早決定勝負，野狐嶺就是這句話的開頭。
resultEn: The result was an outright Mongol victory, and a clean one. At Yehuling the Jin centre collapsed and the front-line commander Wanyan Jiujin was killed; at Huihe Fortress, after three days of encirclement, Genghis Khan led three thousand horsemen in the last charge, the Jin army was destroyed and the commander-in-chief Wanyan Chengyu escaped with his life alone. Two chancellors changed, the Jin sovereign Wanyan Yongji was killed in Zhongdu by his own general Hushahu, and the court fell back from Zhongdu to Bianjing; the screen that had covered the plain of Hebei was rewritten. The Mongols took three things away: Han grain, iron and horses to keep the war going, the craftsmen of the Central Plain who could build siege engines, and a method of fighting offence in place of defence, which did not require holding their own walls so much as destroying the enemy army in the open. The Jin did not fall at once, holding half the empire until 1234, but their defence had turned from attacking to enduring. For the counterweight trebuchet on the card, Yehuling was not its battlefield, for no artillery took part here, yet this war gave it money, material and men: the Mongols carried into Hebei the siege capacity assembled here, and later built the counterweight engine along the same line of technology until it beat down Xiangyang, the southern city that had never fallen. Engineering settles a siege before the weapons do, and Yehuling is where that sentence begins.
